_note: Thomas, 2026-09-05: 'find France, Italy, Netherlands, Denmark, Czechia and Norway's price indexes, they must have one.' The ESMS pass had found Eurostat publishing HICP national reference metadata for all six while the corpus had no price-index node for any of them. Each node's url is the NSI's own page for the index (read live from the sandbox, 200, description quoted from it); the weight-source edges quote Eurostat's prc_hicp_esms*_<cc>.htm section 18.1.1 verbatim, and the eurostat-hicp edges quote the same pages' transmission sentences where one exists (DK, IT, NL, NO — FR and CZ say only that the HICP is released on Eurostat's calendar, so no edge). The Netherlands also had no national-accounts node at all, so nl-cbs-national-accounts is minted here from CBS's own research description page. No HBS nodes exist for these six countries; the ESMS HBS sentences are recorded as leads in _dropped.

reports.title: Indice des prix à la consommation (IPC) / Indice des prix à la consommation harmonisé (IPCH) — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (INSEE)
reports.description: INSEE's monthly consumer price index and its harmonised counterpart, described on INSEE's source page 'Élaboration de l'indice des prix à la consommation (IPC) et de l'indice des prix à la consommation harmonisé (IPCH)': "L’IPC est l’instrument de mesure de l’inflation. Il permet d’estimer, entre deux périodes données, la variation du niveau général des prix des biens et des services consommés par les ménages sur le territoire français." The same page notes the IPC is "publié au Journal officiel chaque mois" and that the IPCH "ne se substituent pas aux IPC nationaux". Weights come from the national accounts (Eurostat's France HICP metadata, section 18.1.1).
reports.cadence_note: INSEE's source page: the IPC is published in the Journal officiel every month; Eurostat's France HICP metadata (8.3) says the HICP and national CPI are disseminated each month in the 'Informations rapides' collection.

reports.title: Prezzi al consumo — indice nazionale (NIC) e indice armonizzato (IPCA) — Consumer Prices / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.description: ISTAT's monthly consumer-price release covering the national index for the whole population (NIC) and the harmonised index (IPCA). The August 2026 provisional release reads: "Secondo le stime preliminari, nel mese di agosto 2026 l’indice nazionale dei prezzi al consumo per l’intera collettività (NIC), al lordo dei tabacchi, registra una variazione pari a +0,5% su base mensile" and "l’indice armonizzato dei prezzi al consumo (IPCA) registra una variazione pari a +0,1% su base mensile". Sub-index weights come from the national accounts (Eurostat's Italy HICP metadata, 18.1.1.3).
reports.cadence_note: Monthly: provisional estimate at month-end, final data mid-following-month (ISTAT 'Prezzi al consumo' press-release series).

reports.title: Consumentenprijsindex (CPI) — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.publisher: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) / Statistics Netherlands
reports.description: CBS's monthly consumer price index (2025=100), whose research description states the purpose as "Het maandelijks publiceren van de prijsontwikkeling van goederen en diensten die consumenten aanschaffen" and the weighting source as "Voor het bepalen van de wegingsfactoren van de verschillende goederen en diensten in de CPI wordt gebruik gemaakt van de consumptieve bestedingen uit de nationale rekeningen." CBS also compiles the Dutch HICP from the same price observation and sends preliminary data to Eurostat for the monthly flash estimate (Eurostat's Netherlands HICP metadata, 8.3).
reports.cadence_note: Monthly ('Het maandelijks publiceren'); a flash estimate precedes the first publication, both provisional until the following month's release.

reports.title: Nationale rekeningen — National Accounts (ESA 2010)
reports.publisher: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) / Statistics Netherlands
reports.description: The Dutch national accounts, described on CBS's research page: "De nationale rekeningen worden opgesteld volgens de richtlijnen van het Europees systeem van Rekeningen." Annual and quarterly figures are published ("Binnen de nationale rekeningen worden zowel data per jaar als data per kwartaal gepubliceerd"), with four annual-figure publication moments ("Er zijn vier publicatiemomenten van jaarcijfers van de nationale rekeningen") and all figures on StatLine each June. Minted 2026-09-05 because the corpus had no Dutch national-accounts node for the CPI weights to point at.
reports.cadence_note: CBS's page: quarterly accounts plus four annual-figure publication moments a year (mid-February flash, end-March, then 6 and 18 months after the reference year); releases_per_year follows the quarterly cadence as the other national-accounts nodes do.

reports.title: Forbrugerprisindeks — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.description: Statistics Denmark's monthly consumer price index. Its statistical documentation states: "Formålet med forbrugerprisindekset er at belyse prisudviklingen for de varer og tjenester, der indgår i husholdningernes forbrug på dansk område. Forbrugerprisindekset er blevet opgjort siden 1914 ... Fra januar 1967 er indekset blevet opgjort månedligt." and "Forbrugerprisindekset opgøres på baggrund af 23.000 priser, der indsamles fra 1.600 butikker, virksomheder og institutioner." Weights come from the national accounts at the top level and the household budget survey below (Eurostat's Denmark HICP metadata, 18.1.1).
reports.cadence_note: Statistics Denmark's documentation: published on the 10th (or first working day after) of the month following the collection month.

reports.title: Indexy spotřebitelských cen — inflace — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.publisher: Český statistický úřad (ČSÚ) / Czech Statistical Office
reports.description: The Czech Statistical Office's monthly consumer-price release ('Inflace, spotřebitelské ceny'), which defines its headline measures: "Míra inflace vyjádřená přírůstkem indexu spotřebitelských cen ke stejnému měsíci předchozího roku vyjadřuje procentní změnu cenové hladiny ve vykazovaném měsíci daného roku proti stejnému měsíci předchozího roku." The page also carries the monthly preliminary estimate ("Předběžný odhad indexu spotřebitelských cen"). Sub-index weights come from the annual national accounts (Eurostat's Czechia HICP metadata, 18.1.1.3); the CPI press release carries the HICP all-items rates as well.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly (ČSÚ page: 'Datum zveřejnění: 11. 08. 2026' for the July figures; Eurostat's Czechia HICP metadata: HICP annual and monthly rates included in the CPI press release).

reports.title: Konsumprisindeksen (KPI) — Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
reports.description: Statistics Norway's monthly consumer price index: "The CPI describes the development in consumer prices for goods and services purchased by private households in Norway, and is a common measure of inflation." SSB's page states "The survey is conducted monthly and is published on the 10th of each month, approximately 10 days after the reference month" and that "The weights are updated in January, and kept constant throughout the rest of the year." Weights are derived from national accounts data (Eurostat's Norway HICP metadata, 18.1.1).
reports.cadence_note: SSB: monthly, published on the 10th of each month.
